svg.text: 33 taxa, 40,920 quartets; W2-sym, W2c 100 resamples, S2 100 replicates, strand filter on, MAW lengths by entropy, seed 1
Square: halo value (orange low, purple high; ● below 0.6). Numbers at nodes: S1/S2. Branch colour and width: S1 (light thin: low; dark thick: high).
Unrooted tree, drawn rooted at the midpoint of its longest path; branch lengths are not drawn. Groups: automatic: clades of the tree.
